Light, refreshing and full of natural citrus flavors, Squirt is also caffeine-free which makes it the perfect drink to enjoy any time of day. When you’re looking for a drink to quench your thirst, the citrus soda always hits the spot. However, if you’re in the mood for a more adult drink for mixers and parties, try adding 1 part tequila to 3 parts Squirt and squeeze in lime for a Paloma, a popular drink in the United States as well as Mexico as far back as the 1950s. Reach for a Squirt Made in Mexico Glass Bottle when you’re looking for a thoroughly satisfying, refreshingly flavorful drink to quench your thirst with a burst of grapefruit and citrus!

In 1946, during the post-war boom of innovation and industry, Niles Foster set his sights on the market for convenient fruit based beverages. What captured his imagination was the idea of an orange drink, bubbly and bright, that would appeal to families seeking vitamins alongside refreshment. It needed to have a balance of tangy citrus and sweet flavors and possess the genuine nutrition of natural Vitamin C, the ingredient that earned the drink its name—Hi-C––because of its high content of Vitamin C compared to competing juices. The drink was immediately a hit in the south and in just a decade became a nationwide success. Over the years a variety of flavors have been added to the Hi-C portfolio.

Instant Corn Masa: To prepare delicious tortillas, just add water. Instructions for the masa: Combine 2 cups of Maseca corn masa flour with 1-1/2 cups of water. Mix thoroughly for 2 minutes until you form a soft dough. If dough feels dry, add teaspoons of water (one by one). Instructions for tortillas: Divide dough into 19 equal balls of approximately 1 ounce each. Cover with a damp cloth to keep dough soft and moist. Line a tortilla press with 2 sheets of thick plastic wrap. Place each ball between the two sheets of plastic and press until tortilla has 5 inches in diameter. Heat skillet or griddle on medium-high heat. Carefully peel off tortilla from plastic wrap. Cook each tortilla for 30 seconds on each side, turning the tortilla 3 times. Cover tortillas with a cloth napkin to keep them soft and warm. To make tostadas, let tortillas cool down before frying in oil. Makes 19 tortillas. For reheating tortillas: Reheat tortillas on a skillet, griddle or microwave. Skillet or griddle: Heat tortillas over medium-high heat for 15 seconds on each side. Repeat as desired. Microwave: Wrap 4 to 6 tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave from 30 to 45 seconds or until heated through. Wrap tortillas in a cloth napkin or store in a tortilla warmer until ready to serve. How to Store Your Tortillas: Once tortillas are cool, place them in a zip close plastic bag and refrigerate. Tortillas can be refrigerated up to a week.

BEN'S ORIGINAL Whole Grain Brown Rice brings a perfect combination of flavor, texture and aroma — everything needed for a tasty side dish. The whole grains of brown rice deliver a low-fat source of fiber to provide an ideal complement to a balanced diet. Together with its earthy aroma and chewy texture, BEN'S ORIGINAL Whole Grain Brown Rice works as an essential part for a variety of cooked rice meals. Preparation is as easy as it can be; simply combine your brown rice with water in a saucepan and bring the water to a boil. Afterwards, reduce the heat to Medium or Medium-Low and let the rice simmer for about 20 minutes. If you prefer firmer rice, then reduce the cooking time and use less water — also consider adding butter for a bit of extra flavor. Once done, fluff with a fork and serve a delectable dish that your family is bound to love. For a savory lunch, use your whole grain rice in a black bean chicken recipe or mix it up with Korean bulgogi paired with soy sauce and ginger. Alternatively, combine the rice with pinto bean salad for an exquisite, vegetarian-friendly lunch. Made with no artificial flavors, colors or preservatives, BEN'S ORIGINAL Brown Rice lets you explore new culinary horizons and serve wholesome meals. Enjoy the moment with every spoonful of Oui by Yoplait French Style Strawberry Whole Milk Yogurt. Pleasure is at the heart of this French style yogurt. It begins with simple ingredients like whole milk and real strawberries, poured into individual glass pots and left to set for eight hours. And voila. . .the culturing process creates a delicious fruit yogurt so thick and creamy, it calls for a proper spoon. So take the time to truly taste. And let your senses be your guide. Enjoy this crafted yogurt cup on a train trip into the city. Take the yogurt jar to the sunniest room at your workplace. Savor spoonfuls as a gluten free snack on a bench outdoors. Each strawberry yogurt is made with live and active cultures and contains no artificial flavors and no colors from artificial sources. Oui yogurt is best experienced without stirring to get just the right amount of fruit from the bottom in every bite. The glass pot protects the delicate, creamy texture while the yogurt sets, as well as during shipping. The result is unparalleled taste and texture for a uniquely French yogurt experience. Oui glass pots are reusable and recyclable. Keep this flavored yogurt cold in the refrigerator until you're ready to pick up a spoon. Say Oui to the French way with Oui French Style Yogurt and Layered Desserts.

Stove Top Cooking Instructions: Place 2 cups of broccoli florets in 1 cup of water. Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt, bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, or until tender. Drain and season to taste. Microwave Instructions: Place broccoli florets in a microwave safe dish with 1/4 cup of water and cover. Microwave on high for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir once halfway through the cycle Drain. Season to taste. Microwave oven may vary. Heating time mayor some adjustments. Cook thoroughly to a temperature of 165 degrees F or 74 degrees C. Keep frozen. Keep frozen until ready to use.

Stove Top Cooking Instructions: For each 1 cup frozen vegetables, heat 1/2 cup water to boiling. Place frozen vegetables in boiling water and add 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a second boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook gently 5 to 7 minutes. Do not overcook. Drain. Season to taste. Microwave Instructions: Place vegetables in microwave casserole. Add 2 tablespoons water and cover. Microwave on high power for 4 to 6 minutes. Stir after first half cooking period. Season to taste. Stir, cover and allow to stand a few minutes before serving. Microwave ovens may vary. Heating time may require adjustment. Cook thoroughly to a temperature of 165 degrees F or 74 degrees C. Keep frozen. Keep frozen until ready to use.

Reduce heat, cover and cook gently 2 to 4 minutes. Do not overcook. Drain. Season to taste. Microwave Instructions: Place vegetables in microwave casserole. Add 2 tablespoons water and cover.
